SEL Level 1 · Reading Others: Voice and Place Clues

✅ Answer · Card 1 of 4

A gift and a happy voice

are happy clues. Two

clues agree!

SEL Level 1 · Reading Others: Voice and Place Clues

🃏 Card 2 of 4

⚽ Their team just lost

the game. Their voice is

very quiet.

Pick! 1

🤩 excited 2 sad 3 happy

SEL Level 1 · Reading Others: Voice and Place Clues

✅ Answer · Card 2 of 4

Sad

Losing and a quiet voice

are sad clues. Some people

feel mad after losing, so

check more clues.

yell. Those are mad clues.

SEL Level 1 · Reading Others: Voice and Place Clues

Sort

Clue Sort: Voice or Place?

👂 A voice clue is how they sound.

📍 A place clue is what just happened or

where they are.

✋ Show 1 finger for voice or 2 fingers for

place.

󾠮 🗣 Voice clue Place clue
